'''Frank Quillen''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Greenwood tournament]] on 20 January 2001 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1654">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-greenwood-in-1-20-01d1654/ greenwood-in-1-20-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 21 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-21-greenwood-in-1-20-01d1654/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
